name: Yayashi SP-4 Ultra Whitening Toothpaste | Stain Remover & Fresh Breath Formula
description:
Yayashi SP-4 Ultra Whitening Toothpaste delivers everyday freshness and brighter smiles with its enamel-safe formula. Designed to remove surface stains, it supports gum health while leaving a refreshing minty feel. Gentle enough for daily use, this toothpaste is suitable for both adults and teens who want cleaner teeth, fresh breath, and long-lasting oral care confidence.
Key Features
 Removes surface stains for whiter teeth
 Fresh mint flavor leaves lasting freshness
 Gentle on enamel, safe for daily use
 Helps support gum health and strength
 Suitable for adults and teens alike
 Dentist-inspired formula for oral care
Ingredients / Materials
Mint flavor, cleansing agents, enamel-safe formula
How to Use
 Apply a pea-sized amount to your toothbrush
 Brush teeth thoroughly for 2–3 minutes
 Rinse mouth with water after brushing
 Use twice daily for best results
Package Includes
 1 × Yayashi SP-4 Ultra Whitening Toothpaste (Mint, 100g approx.)
